div.div: Data Intelligence & Governance for Splunk data readiness, CIM alignment, onboarding opportunity, and operational value.

p.strong: DIG Navigator helps you understand the operational value and readiness of data in Splunk.

div.p: Use DIG to review data structure, quality, field evidence, CIM tag context, datamodel readiness, governance alignment, telemetry timeliness, and onboarding opportunities.
DIG does not replace Splunk expertise or CIM validation tooling. It gives administrators, engineers, analysts, and governance stakeholders a shared evidence base for deciding what to improve next.

ol.li: First time run? Make sure to navigate to the Configuration page to create the necessary lookups that help to power this app.
Start with Data Intelligence to identify data quality, structure, CIM alignment, and datamodel readiness concerns.
Review Data Governance to understand freshness, timeliness, coverage, retention, and governance alignment signals.
Use DIG Intelligence Nexus (IN) dashboards to investigate the evidence behind executive-level findings.
Act on the evidence by updating onboarding, field extractions, CIM tags, datamodel alignment, governance mappings, or telemetry timeliness rules where appropriate.
